data.message: Retrieving the official financial statement PDF from the CSE document repository
Document secured and staged for processing
Running multi-dimensional financial health diagnostics with LLM (this may take a minute)...
Health diagnostics finalised for HNB.N0000 — overall score: 86/100 · Good

standardHealthChecks.name: Liquidity Health
standardHealthChecks.description: Liquidity positions are exceptionally strong and comfortably exceed regulatory minimums. The All-Currency Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) stands at 194.44% (vs 100% minimum) and Rupee LCR at 198.83%, backed by a Net Stable Funding Ratio of 126.36%.

standardHealthChecks.name: Profitability Health
standardHealthChecks.description: Net Interest Income expanded by 13.5% YoY to Rs 26.9 Bn, driven by NIM widening from 4.26% to 4.45%. Profit After Tax stood at Rs 9.95 Bn (Bank) and Rs 10.36 Bn (Group), slightly lower YoY (-2.73%) due to elevated credit impairment provisions of Rs 2.55 Bn (vs. a reversal of Rs 379.7 Mn in Q1 2025). Return on Equity was healthy at 14.74%.

standardHealthChecks.name: Debt Management
standardHealthChecks.description: Leverage remains well-controlled with a Bank Debt Equity Ratio of 12.77% and Subordinated Term Debts standing at Rs 28.84 Bn against total shareholders' equity of Rs 269.59 Bn. Regulatory leverage ratio stands at 7.18%, safely higher than the 3.00% requirement.

standardHealthChecks.name: Cash Flow Health
standardHealthChecks.description: Operating profit before working capital changes grew strongly to Rs 18.67 Bn (vs Rs 10.08 Bn in Q1 2025). Operating cash flow netted Rs 3.39 Bn due to substantial credit growth (loans and advances increased by Rs 108.9 Bn during the quarter). Cash and cash equivalents remained solid at Rs 67.54 Bn.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Asset Quality (Stage 3 NPL Ratio & Coverage)
dynamicHealthChecks.description: Asset quality indicators remain remarkably sound despite economic volatility. The Net Stage 3 ratio stood at 1.18% (1.09% at Dec 2025), while Stage 3 provision coverage remained highly defensive at 73.29%.
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: Essential metric for commercial banks to assess underlying credit portfolio risk and loss absorption buffers.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Capital Adequacy Ratio (Basel III)
dynamicHealthChecks.description: Capital buffers provide substantial headroom above regulatory thresholds. Bank Tier 1 Capital Ratio stands at 15.03% (vs 9.50% minimum) and Total Capital Ratio stands at 18.07% (vs 13.50% minimum).
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: Core measure of a bank's financial solvency and ability to withstand potential macroeconomic shocks and unexpected operational losses.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Net Interest Margin (NIM) & Revenue Efficiency
dynamicHealthChecks.description: NIM improved to 4.45% from 4.26% in FY2025, supported by disciplined loan book expansion and stable funding costs. Net fee and commission income also logged strong momentum, growing 40.9% YoY to Rs 6.8 Bn.
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: Primary indicator of a bank's fundamental earning power and ability to price loans effectively relative to funding costs.

recommendations: Maintain prudent credit risk management and monitoring on loan originations to keep Stage 3 ratio stable amid elevated macro volatility.
Sustain cost efficiency initiatives to preserve the strong Cost-to-Income ratio (37.15%) as customer transaction volumes and card activity grow.
Leverage the growing deposit base and strong liquidity buffers to continue expansion in high-yield leasing and trade-finance segments.
Further expand digital banking adoption to scale non-interest fee and commission streams.
result.analysisNotes: Hatton National Bank PLC displays strong core financial health in Q1 2026. Balance sheet growth was robust, with Total Assets crossing Rs 2.5 Tn and Total Deposits exceeding Rs 2.0 Tn. Capital adequacy and liquidity buffers are among the strongest in the sector, providing ample capacity for growth while offering deep loss-absorption capacity.
